name: Cherry
trivia: Cherry tomatoes are bite-sized and often the sweetest on the vine. Every garden starts small.

name: Roma
trivia: Roma tomatoes are egg-shaped and meaty, with few seeds — perfect for sauce.

name: Yellow Pear
trivia: Yellow Pear tomatoes are shaped like tiny pears and have been grown since the 1800s.

name: Sungold
trivia: Sungold is an orange cherry tomato famous for tasting almost like fruit candy.

name: Green Zebra
trivia: Green Zebra stays green when ripe, with yellow stripes. It was bred in 1983.

name: Momotaro
trivia: Momotaro (桃太郎) is a beloved Japanese pink tomato, named after the peach boy of the folk tale.

name: San Marzano
trivia: San Marzano tomatoes come from the volcanic soil near Mount Vesuvius in Italy.

name: Black Krim
trivia: Black Krim is a dusky, purple-brown heirloom from the Crimean peninsula.

name: Brandywine
trivia: Brandywine is a big pink heirloom, a favourite of gardeners for over a century.

name: First Light
trivia: Katakana, finished! Like a tomato warming in the morning sun, your loanwords are ripening.

name: Beefsteak
trivia: Beefsteak tomatoes can weigh over 500 g each — one slice covers a sandwich.

name: Golden Harvest
trivia: A hundred ripe plants. That's a real harvest — a gardener's whole summer in one basket.
